narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Class Routine"**

The desk is set like the department's printed class routine: a white sheet, days running across, PCs running down, group codes typed into ruled cells. Ink rules carry the structure and grow heavier at each day boundary. Routine blue owns two things only: the shell bar that frames every page, and time (today's column, the slot running now, the primary action). Everything else is ink on white, with a pale blue-grey second layer for panels, table heads and the status line.

Density is spreadsheet density. The full week for every PC has to stay readable in one view on a laptop, so the type is small and even (14px body, 13px inside the grid), numerals are tabular everywhere, and nothing decorative competes with state. What is live, what is pending and what has failed outrank everything else. Each thesis group appears as a highlighter tint behind its bold capital code, the way a student marks their own classes on a printed routine. Choosing a group in the legend highlights its cells and dims the rest.

The world rejects the admin-template look: no cards, no pills, no grey sidebar, no drop shadows. Grouping comes from a ruled heading or a flat panel fill. On a phone the routine turns into one PC's week per screen, and each swipe snaps to the next PC.
keyCharacteristics: White sheet ground with ink rules: 2px at day boundaries and the PC column, 1px soft rules inside a day.
Routine blue for the shell, today and the live slot, never as decoration.
Group identity is a highlighter tint behind a bold uppercase code; pending is hollow and dashed.
System sans throughout with tabular numerals; one type size inside the grid.
Flat colour only: depth comes from the panel layer, state comes from inset rings.

rules.name: The Routine Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue means the frame or the clock: the shell, today, the live slot, the one primary action, links and focus. If blue isn't marking one of those, it shouldn't be there.

rules.name: The Highlighter Rule
rules.body: A group's colour appears only as the tint behind its bold capital code and in its legend swatch. Never use it as a text colour, a border, a row fill or a chart series.

rules.name: The State Reserve Rule
rules.body: Red, amber and green are spent only on state (failed, waiting, healthy), always paired with a word. They are never used for decoration or categories.

rules.name: The One Size Grid Rule
rules.body: Inside the routine everything is set at 13px. Weight, case and tint separate code from caption; size never does.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Numerals are tabular everywhere. Times, dates and counts must line up down a column.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never lift. If something needs to stand apart, give it the Panel fill or a rule; box-shadow is used only as an inset ring for hover, selection, clash or the current tab.

dos: **Do** frame every page with the Routine Blue shell and the Panel status line. State is always one glance away.
**Do** separate days with 2px Ink rules, and separate halves and rows with 1px Soft Rules.
**Do** show a group only as its bold uppercase code on its highlighter tint, and show pending as a hollow dashed code with "?".
**Do** pair every state colour with a word ("Switch failed", "dry-run", "4 awaiting approval").
**Do** build sections from a 2px Ink rule and a 17px heading, and use the flat Panel fill when a block must stand apart.
**Do** keep numerals tabular and keep the grid at a single 13px size.
**Do** keep Ink 3 (4.9:1) as the lightest text on white.
donts: **Don't** wrap content in cards with drop shadows, and don't add a grey sidebar. The admin-template look is what this world refuses.
**Don't** use outer or ambient shadows. Inset rings for hover, selection, clash and the current tab are the only box-shadows.
**Don't** use rounded-full pills for chips, badges or buttons. Corners stop at 4px, and circles are reserved for 8px status dots.
**Don't** spend Routine Blue on decoration, illustration or secondary emphasis.
**Don't** use a group's colour as text, border or background outside its code mark and swatch.
**Don't** put uppercase eyebrow labels above headings. Uppercase tracked type is for column heads and the legend label only.
**Don't** invent or imitate a BRACU logo or identity asset. The lab name in text is the brand.
